idea_one_liner: Livestock-native inventory SaaS for 1-3 location independent reptile/exotic-pet shops.
defensibility_rationale: A boring, tiny vertical no VC-backed team wants to build: reptile-retail back-office. That is the moat — incumbents (Square/Lightspeed) will not add morph/feeding/mortality modelling for a few thousand shops, and the livestock-native data model is a philosophy gap that is hard to bolt on. Risk: the same smallness that repels competitors also caps SOM.

sociological_trend.name: Professionalisation of the post-2020 exotic-pet retail boom
sociological_trend.why_it_lifts_this_idea: A cohort of shops opened during the 2020-2023 reptile-keeping surge and is now formalising back-office operations, creating first-time demand for real inventory software over spreadsheets.

technological_trend.name: Commoditised vertical-SaaS stacks (managed DB + auth + hosting)
technological_trend.why_it_lifts_this_idea: A solo founder can now build and run a niche vertical tool cheaply enough that a few-thousand-shop TAM is economically viable — impossible a decade ago.
